meta.title: RILKE Fluid Systems — Kneeling & Leveling Valves · Made in Canada
meta.description: RILKE designs and manufactures pneumatic and fluid-control components for transit buses, coaches and heavy trucks: kneeling and leveling valves, air compressors, air dryers and more. Engineered by Technoforme. ISO 9001 · FMVSS · Made in Canada.

hero.eyebrow: Fluid control for transit buses, coaches & heavy trucks
hero.text: From a single valve to a complete pneumatic architecture, RILKE designs, tests and manufactures the components that keep transit fleets in service — starting with kneeling and leveling valves.
hero.cta2: Have a part you can't source?
hero.badge: Engineered & manufactured in Canada by Technoforme

products.title: A complete fluid-control portfolio.
products.desc: Every family is designed and built under one roof, with consistent RILKE marking and direct access to the engineers who made it.

featured.title: Kneeling & Leveling Valves
featured.desc: Two complementary valves for the same air suspension — same buyer, same technician, same service interval.

items.name: Kneeling Valve
items.desc: Lowers the floor for boarding. Built for ADA-compliant accessible transit and urban duty cycles.

items.name: Leveling Valve
items.desc: Holds constant ride height under any load by adjusting air-spring pressure automatically.

items.title: Air Compressors
items.desc: Heavy-duty compressors that charge the brake and suspension air system.

items.title: Air Dryers
items.desc: Desiccant dryers that protect air-brake systems from moisture and contaminants.

items.title: Automatic Drain Valves
items.desc: Electric and pressure-operated condensate removal for air reservoirs.

items.title: Air Suspension Components
items.desc: Components for bus, coach and truck air suspension systems.

items.title: Manifolds & Valve Blocks
items.desc: Modular blocks that combine several pneumatic functions in one body.

items.title: Solenoid Valves
items.desc: Electrically actuated valves for pneumatic and hydraulic control.

items.title: Hydraulic Valves
items.desc: Directional and pressure-control valves for hydraulic circuits.

items.title: Hose Assemblies
items.desc: Air-brake, pneumatic and hydraulic hose assemblies for demanding service.

items.title: Fittings & Connectors
items.desc: Precision fittings for secure, leak-free fluid connections.

bus.title: Designed around the complete bus air system.
bus.desc: We treat compression, drying, storage, drainage, kneeling, leveling and suspension as one system — not as isolated parts.

panels.title: Kneeling, leveling & suspension control
panels.desc: Pneumatic control for accessibility, ride height and stability, validated for North American transit requirements.

panels.title: From valve to manifold to system
panels.desc: Where integration adds value, we combine several functions into one compact manifold engineered for the application.

engineering.title: Catalog parts when they fit. Engineering when they don't.
engineering.desc: Behind every RILKE part is Technoforme's in-house design, prototyping and manufacturing. When a standard part won't do, we build the right one.

items.title: Application Engineering
items.desc: Pressure, media, voltage, duty cycle, environment, flow and interfaces translated into the right component architecture.

items.title: Reverse Engineering
items.desc: Dimensional reconstruction, material review, sealing analysis and 3D CAD for obsolete or unavailable parts.

items.title: OEM Development
items.desc: Custom valves, manifolds and assemblies taken from prototype to controlled production — under NDA if required.

rescue.title: Have a part you can't source?
rescue.text: Send us the part number, a drawing, a photo or a sample. We'll evaluate it, reverse-engineer an equivalent or develop a custom replacement for obsolete and discontinued components.

technology.title: Every component can carry its identity.
technology.desc: We're building RILKE around traceability: permanent marking, laser-engraved QR codes and digital access to part information and service history.

tiles.title: Laser-engraved ID
tiles.desc: Permanent identification on valves, manifolds and assemblies.

tiles.title: QR traceability
tiles.desc: Quick access to the right part family, technical data and replacement information.

tiles.title: Lot traceability
tiles.desc: ISO 9001 production records follow each batch from machining to shipment.

tiles.title: Direct engineering support
tiles.desc: A short path from an installed part to service, replacement or redesign.
